opening.argument: The material promotes deployment of a front-running bot while advertising a “10X BNB Return!” and possible earnings of “upwards of a thousand bnb day.” It directs viewers to “Deposit funds to exact your bot contract address,” connect a wallet, and activate the bot after confirmation. The promised mechanism is presented as automatic: it will sell within a minute and transfer 90% back to the wallet, while funds may be sent to a migrator address. Yet the contract’s behavior, destination control, and actual profits are not verified. The separately advertised 30 BNB giveaway and external form are likewise not established as connected to the bot activity.
